decision.title: Workflow Quality Audit
decision.summary: Accept a workflow only when it addresses a repeated operator decision and produces a stable evidence-backed handoff.

claims.text: Review a proposed research workflow for a repeated decision, a distinct source strategy, an explicit output contract, and disconfirming evidence.
